arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-worker-cwd.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 2 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = c39ee2add4862e902d6fb9c0ac6bfaa1d867a6ed
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("codex/dual.py")
source=p.read_text()
before='''    code, stdout, stderr, termination = _invoke_codex(
        cmd, _prompt(task), timeout, cancel_event,
    )
'''
after='''    code, stdout, stderr, termination = _invoke_codex(
        cmd, _prompt(task), timeout, cancel_event, cwd=workspace,
    )
'''
assert source.count(before)==1, "EXPECTED_WORKER_SPAWN_ANCHOR"
p.write_text(source.replace(before,after,1))
p=Path("codex/tests/test_smart.py")
source=p.read_text()
anchor="    def test_single_codex_is_actually_one_worker_with_bounded_scope_and_budget(self):"
assert source.count(anchor)==1
test='''    def test_codex_cli_child_starts_inside_independent_writable_clone(self):
        planned = plan({
            "request": "Implement channel navigation and run tests",
            "target_repository": "martaxi-boss/pink-iptv",
            "work_items": [task("one", "docs/channels",
                                "Implement channel navigation and run tests")],
        })
        with mock.patch.object(smart.dual, "_invoke_codex",
                               wraps=smart.dual._invoke_codex) as invoked:
            result = smart.execute(planned, self.repo, self.runs, timeout=30)
        self.assertEqual([x["status"] for x in result["workers"]], ["completed"])
        self.assertEqual(invoked.call_count, 1)
        child_cwd = invoked.call_args.kwargs["cwd"]
        self.assertEqual(child_cwd, Path(result["workers"][0]["workspace"]))
        self.assertTrue(child_cwd.is_dir())
        self.assertNotEqual(child_cwd.resolve(), self.repo.resolve())
        self.assertEqual(smart.dual._git(self.repo, "status", "--porcelain"), "")

'''
p.write_text(source.replace(anchor,test+anchor,1))
print("CLI_CWD_FIX_APPLIED=YES",flush=True)

PY
